notes.title: v. 0.3.12 Map Editor Update
notes.notes:
With this update you are now able to upload custom models in the Map Editor. Please see the respective Guide on how to do it.

Further additions:
- minor fixes for the map editor
- added a help-message to the map editor
- added multiple movement-arrows to the map editor for different states (movement, rotation, scaling)
- added stepping sizes for easier movement/rotation/scaling with the mouse

notes.title: Leaderboard Update
notes.notes:
With this update you can now access the leaderboards for all levels (Singleplayer and Multiplayer) from the Main Menu.
This includes an actual podest showing the players occupying the the first three places (*wow* *such cool*)!

Additional minor improvements:
- Arrows now do not become completely dark while blinking, making them easier to see
